name: crm
description: CRM for humans and agents: companies, contacts, a deal pipeline with stages and close reasons, a timeline of activities, and next steps with due dates.

requiredTables.name: companies
requiredTables.description: Companies with name, website, industry and notes.

requiredTables.name: contacts
requiredTables.description: Contacts with name, email (unique, case-insensitive), phone, role and an optional company.

requiredTables.name: deals
requiredTables.description: Sales opportunities with company, optional contact, amount in cents, stage, expected close date, owner, and for won or lost deals the close time and reason.

requiredTables.name: activities
requiredTables.description: History: notes, calls, emails and meetings for contacts, companies or deals. Stage changes are logged here automatically.

requiredTables.name: next_steps
requiredTables.description: Next steps with a due date on a deal, company or contact, with owner. Completing one writes an activity to the timeline.

requiredTables.name: event_outbox
requiredTables.description: Events waiting to be delivered to the platform (deal won or lost, next step assigned or due): one row per event, written in the same transaction as the change, with attempts and the last error. Deleted after delivery.

requiredTables.name: next_step_due_notices
requiredTables.description: For which due date a next step was already reported as due, so each due step is reported once.

requiredTables.name: refs_outbox
requiredTables.description: References waiting to be delivered to the platform (set_refs): one row per note or next step with the full set of its @{app:type:id} references and mentions, written in the same transaction as the change. Deleted after delivery.

offeredTools.name: companies.list
offeredTools.description: Lists companies alphabetically. Arguments: q (optional, free text, searches name, industry and website, case-insensitive), limit (optional, 1 to 200, default 50). Returns { companies: [{ id, name, website, industry, notes, contactCount, openDealCount }] }. Use the id for companies.get or as companyId in other tools.

offeredTools.name: companies.get
offeredTools.description: Gets a company with everything that belongs to it. Argument: id (company UUID). Returns { company, contacts, deals, activities, nextSteps }; activities are the latest 20, including those on the company's contacts and deals, newest first; nextSteps are the open ones, also from its contacts and deals, by due date. An unknown id returns 404.

offeredTools.name: companies.create
offeredTools.description: Creates a company. Arguments: name (required, 1 to 200 characters), website (optional, e.g. https://example.com; https:// is added if no scheme is given), industry (optional), notes (optional, free text). Returns { company } with the new id. Check with companies.list first whether the company already exists.

offeredTools.name: contacts.list
offeredTools.description: Lists contacts alphabetically. Arguments: q (optional, searches name, email, phone and role), companyId (optional, only contacts of this company), limit (optional, 1 to 200, default 50). Returns { contacts: [{ id, name, email, phone, role, companyId, companyName }] }.

offeredTools.name: contacts.get
offeredTools.description: Gets a contact with its deals, the latest 20 activities and its open next steps. Argument: id (contact UUID). Returns { contact, deals, activities, nextSteps }. An unknown id returns 404.

offeredTools.name: contacts.create
offeredTools.description: Creates a contact. Arguments: name (required), email (optional, unique, case-insensitive; if it is taken you get an error, then look up the existing contact with contacts.list and q), phone, role (optional), companyId (optional, UUID of an existing company). Returns { contact }.

offeredTools.name: contacts.update
offeredTools.description: Updates a contact. Arguments: id (required) and at least one of name, email, phone, role, companyId. Only the fields you pass change. null (or empty text) clears email, phone, role or companyId; name cannot be cleared. Returns { contact }.

offeredTools.name: deals.list
offeredTools.description: Lists deals by expected close date. Optional: q (searches title, company and contact name), stage, status (open or closed), companyId, contactId, owner (exact user id), limit (1 to 200, default 50). Returns { deals: [{ id, title, companyId, companyName, contactId, contactName, valueCents, stage, expectedClose, owner, closedAt, closeReason, nextStep }] }. valueCents is in euro cents; nextStep is the earliest open step { id, title, dueOn, overdue } or null.

offeredTools.name: deals.get
offeredTools.description: Gets a deal with its timeline and next steps. Argument: id (deal UUID). Returns { deal, activities, nextSteps }; activities are the latest 50, newest first; nextSteps are all steps of the deal, open ones first by due date, then done ones. An unknown id returns 404.

offeredTools.name: deals.create
offeredTools.description: Creates a deal. Arguments: title (required), companyId (required), valueCents (required, whole euro cents, €12,500 = 1250000), contactId (optional, must belong to the company), stage (optional: lead, qualified or proposal, default lead; close it later with deals.update_stage and a reason), expectedClose (optional, YYYY-MM-DD), owner (optional, default: the caller). Returns { deal }.

offeredTools.name: deals.update
offeredTools.description: Updates a deal. Arguments: id (required) and at least one of title, valueCents (whole euro cents), expectedClose (YYYY-MM-DD), owner, contactId (must belong to the deal's company). Only the fields you pass change; null (or empty text) clears expectedClose, owner or contactId. The stage cannot be changed here, use deals.update_stage. Returns { deal }.

offeredTools.name: deals.update_stage
offeredTools.description: Moves a deal to a stage: lead, qualified, proposal, won, lost. Arguments: id (required), stage (required), note (the reason; required for won and lost, optional otherwise). Won or lost stores the note as closeReason and sets closedAt; moving back to an open stage clears both. A change writes an activity (kind note, subject 'Stage: Old → New', body = note). If the deal already has that stage, nothing changes and no activity is written. Returns { deal, changed, activity }.

offeredTools.name: activities.log
offeredTools.description: Logs an activity. Arguments: kind (required: note, call, email, meeting), subject (required, short line), body (optional, free text), contactId, companyId, dealId (at least one of them), happenedAt (optional, ISO timestamp, default now). If companyId is missing, it is taken from the deal or contact. Returns { activity }. Mention someone or link an item of another app with @{human:<email>} or @{app:type:id} in subject or body.

offeredTools.name: activities.list
offeredTools.description: Lists activities, newest first. Arguments: contactId, companyId, dealId (optional, combinable; companyId also finds activities on the company's contacts and deals), limit (optional, 1 to 200, default 50). Without a filter: the newest across all records. Returns { activities }.

offeredTools.name: next_steps.list
offeredTools.description: Lists next steps. Optional: status (open = default, overdue = open and due before today in Europe/Berlin, done, all), dealId, companyId (also steps on its deals and contacts), contactId, owner (exact user id), limit (1 to 200, default 50). Open steps first by due date. Returns { nextSteps: [{ id, title, dueOn, overdue, dealId, dealTitle, companyId, companyName, contactId, contactName, owner, doneAt, doneBy }] }.

offeredTools.name: next_steps.create
offeredTools.description: Plans a next step. Arguments: title (required, what to do, 1 to 200 characters), dueOn (required, YYYY-MM-DD), dealId, companyId, contactId (at least one of them), owner (optional, default: the caller). If companyId is missing, it is taken from the deal or contact. Returns { nextStep }.

offeredTools.name: next_steps.complete
offeredTools.description: Marks a next step as done. Arguments: id (required), note (optional, the outcome). Writes an activity (kind note, subject 'Done: <title>', body = note) to the timeline. If the step is already done, nothing changes. Returns { nextStep, changed, activity }.

offeredTools.name: next_steps.reopen
offeredTools.description: Reopens a next step that was marked done, e.g. to undo next_steps.complete. Argument: id (required). Writes an activity (kind note, subject 'Reopened: <title>'). If the step is already open, nothing changes. Returns { nextStep, changed, activity }.

offeredTools.name: pipeline.summary
offeredTools.description: Summarises the pipeline, no arguments. Returns { stages: [{ stage, count, sumCents, probability, weightedCents }], totals: { count, openCount, openSumCents, weightedOpenCents, wonCents, lostCents } }. Weighting: lead 10 %, qualified 25 %, proposal 60 %, won 100 %, lost 0 %. weightedOpenCents is the weighted total of open deals.

offeredTools.name: search
offeredTools.description: Searches companies (name, industry, website), contacts (name, email, phone, role) and deals (title) at once, case-insensitive. Arguments: query (1 to 200 characters), limit (1 to 20, default 5). Returns {hits: [{id, title, snippet, url, kind}]}: kind is company, contact or deal, url the path in the CRM (/deals/<id>), names starting with the query first. The CRM's tool for the platform search; use the get tool of the kind for details.

offeredTools.name: crm.resolve
offeredTools.description: Resolves references to companies, contacts, deals, activities and next steps for chips in other apps. Arguments: type (company, contact, deal, activity or next-step), ids (1 to 50 ids). Returns {objects: [{id, title, path, status, updatedAt}]}; unknown ids are left out, deals carry their stage. The platform calls it for resolve_refs after checking that the viewer may read the CRM.

events.description: A deal moved to won. Goes to the deal owner.
A deal moved to lost. Goes to the deal owner.
Someone planned a next step for another person. Goes to that person.
An open next step is due today or overdue (Europe/Berlin). Goes to its owner, once per due date.

objects.description: A deal with its stage. Reference: crm:deal:<id>.
A logged note, call, mail or meeting. Reference: crm:activity:<id>.
A next step with due date. Reference: crm:next-step:<id>.

requestedGrants.reason: Who may open the CRM. Which group is decided by the grant in the control plane; a requested right is a request, not an assignment.
The CRM reports won and lost deals and next steps to the platform inbox. Without this grant events wait in the outbox; saving in the CRM is never affected.

The CRM reports the @{app:type:id} references and mentions in notes and next steps, so other apps show them as backlinks and mentioned people get a notification. Without this grant references wait in the outbox; saving is never affected.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Connection to the app's own schema, using the app role. Set by the control plane. Without it the app starts without migrations and every query fails.

env.name: DATABASE_SCHEMA
env.description: The app's own schema. The SDK derives the search_path from it; a DSN with options= is rejected.

env.name: OPENAPPS_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: App-specific secret the SDK uses to verify the gateway signature. Set by the control plane per deployment.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_ID
env.description: Id of this app in the signed material. Must be byte-identical to what the gateway writes.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_HOST
env.description: Shared domain in the signed material, trimmed and lowercased.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_BASE_PATH
env.description: Path the app lives under (/crm). Must be set at build time, otherwise links and images point nowhere.

env.name: OPENAPPS_PLATFORM_URL
env.description: Address of the control plane in the platform network. The SDK delivers events and references through it. Set by the control plane.

env.name: OPENAPPS_CALL_SECRET
env.description: The app's own secret for calls to the platform. Set by the control plane per deployment; never logged.

egress.reason: Events and references go to the platform through the control plane (OPENAPPS_PLATFORM_URL).
